provenance.editing: Only the final Safari app tour is used. Earlier chat and setup footage is excluded. Native recording controls and desktop edges are cropped. Idle periods are cut; two silent navigation/message-composition sections are accelerated. Original call-playback sections remain at normal speed. No product state or transcript is fabricated. The remaining bottom desktop-pet overlay is cropped out; the retained app viewport is letterboxed without changing product content or covering primary actions.
provenance.callEvidence: UI explicitly labels playback RECORDED TEST · 8 NOV, with an excerpt of the original 88-second completed Hindi call.
